tasks.short: Check ingredient maturity and finished food quality

steps.what: Check ingredients and finished products through sampling, testing and scientific assessment

tasks.design: Keep sampling, testing and interpretation with the food scientist, retaining context in {DOCS}. No machine infers that an ingredient or finished product is safe from incomplete measurements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safety and quality depend on representative samples and interpretation of findings.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing test procedures and documents support the assessment.
tasks.still_hard: Unrepresentative samples and conflicting sensory, chemical or microbiological findings.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist questions the evidence and decides what further testing is needed.

reach.learn: Preserve sampling context and method limitations

evidence.claim: Keeping scientific food assessment manual is the proposed design; the digest establishes no measured saving for this task.

assumptions: The baseline covers material assessment, not a separate report-writing task.
The food scientist produces samples, test observations and interpretations within s1 with all time retained; no pre-existing safety flag is assumed.
Existing laboratory methods and DOCS suffice before any new platform.
No new service or incremental upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Is there a repetitive calculation distinct from scientific assessment with known reference results?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gives zero gross and net saving. No report preparation or automatic release saving is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study methods to improve food characteristics

steps.what: Design and conduct studies of food composition, flavor, texture and convenience
Interpret study results and select methods for improving foods

tasks.design: Retain experimental design, practical studies and interpretation with the food scientist, using {DOCS} for evidence. Searching current literature is assigned to the separate staying-current task and is not counted again here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Food improvements require empirical testing of interacting characteristics.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing experimental methods support repeatable studies without replacing scientific judgment.
tasks.still_hard: Sensory trade-offs, reproducibility and changes at production scale.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognizes meaningful differences and chooses further experiments.

reach.learn: Distinguish measured relationships from causal explanations

evidence.claim: Manual experimental food development is the proposed design; no empirical food improvement saving is established in the digest.

assumptions: This baseline is experimental research, not mass literature screening or report drafting.
The food scientist produces study observations and results in s1; capture remains fully counted.
Existing experiment records in DOCS precede any custom research tool.
No added model or service needs incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Does the work contain repeatable numerical analysis that can be separated and benchmarked?

already_counted.description: Experimental design, evidence collection and interpretation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gives zero gross and net saving; literature-search savings belong to another task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop food standards and production specifications

steps.what: Define food standards and gather applicable production and safety evidence
Draft production specifications and sanitary requirements from the approved evidence packet

loop.purpose: Organize selected requirements into a controlled specification draft
loop.input: Scientist's brief and versioned source excerpts
loop.output: Draft with requirement identifiers and unresolved questions
loop.check: Validate source identifiers and compare every limit, unit and condition against the cited source; the scientist assesses completeness and applicability
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved limits remain blank and return to manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template handles headings but does not organize varied process evidence into explanatory clauses

steps.what: Verify food standards and finalize specifications for formal authorization

tasks.design: Use controlled {DOCS} templates and a bounded drafting assistant after the scientist selects applicable evidence. The output remains a reviewed proposal; issuing binding rules or changing production controls is outside this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly organizing source requirements and production evidence into specifications.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting from selected evidence can reduce prose preparation without delegating technical limits.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, conflicting requirements and validation of safety limits.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist decides which requirements are justified by the process evidence.

reach.learn: Make each requirement testable and traceable

evidence.claim: A source-grounded specification drafting loop is a proposed E1 design, not a measured deployment of a food standards product.

assumptions: The task develops specifications rather than enacting external regulations or changing operating equipment.

In s1 the scientist produces requirement identifier, source version, applicable process, limit, unit and evidence reference, with 40 hours including capture. Missing or conflicting applicability goes to manual review.
Native document templates and controlled clause libraries precede a model.
The assistant cannot invent a safety threshold or authorize production release.
research_questions: Can reviewed drafts preserve every source limit and expose unsupported clauses while reducing total preparation time?

already_counted.description: Requirement capture, draft correction and technical review

incremental.description: Maintain source versions and audit specification errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=91.25 yields 8.75 gross less 5 focal upkeep =3.75 central net. Report 0-1 until specification reviews are timed; complex applicability can erase drafting gains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep current with food science and regulatory literature

steps.what: Define scientific literature searches and select authoritative regulatory update channels
Retrieve new scientific literature and distribute matching update alerts
Review literature and verify the meaning and applicability of new regulations

tasks.design: Configure saved searches and source alerts in the literature search service {OTHER}, delivering links through {EMAIL}. The scientist still reads original material and checks regulatory status; relevance or legal applicability is never an automatic conclusion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly checking the same sources for new material.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved searches and publication alerts can replace repeated retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Search coverage, publication quality and whether a change applies to a particular process.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist interprets evidence and distinguishes proposals from effective requirements.

reach.learn: Test search recall and avoid overly narrow terms

evidence.claim: Saved searches and source alerts are a proposed native configuration approach; no food-science time reduction is measured here.

assumptions: Only repeated retrieval is removed; reading, evaluation and interpretation retain their full time.

In s1 the scientist produces query terms, source identifiers, date filters, jurisdictions and delivery frequency; 15 hours include capture and initial coverage checks. Sources without alerts remain manual within s3.
OTHER means existing literature search service; native alerts precede custom retrieval or model summaries.
No claim that an alert feed is complete or legally authoritative.
research_questions: Do configured alerts find known relevant updates without increasing total screening time?

already_counted.description: Search definition, source selection and substantive reading

incremental.description: Maintain queries and check missed updates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=80 gives 20 gross less 5 focal upkeep =15 central net. Report 0-4 while repeated retrieval prevalence is unknown; the low case already has alerts or requires manual source checking.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Scientific food judgment supported by controlled information handling
reach: Coordinate with technicians on sample context
Learn search quality checks from librarians
role.ambitious_version: A food scientist who spends less time assembling updates and prose while retaining experimental and safety judgment
